# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working on this repository. It is the
single source of truth for the project layout, runtime, design system, checks,
CI/CD and deployment constraints.

Run npm commands from `static-web-app/` with Node.js 22, as specified in
`static-web-app/.nvmrc`. Preserve the static export and the disabled blog.
All deployments run through GitHub Actions.
